Ready to pay? お会計をお願いします。
Okaikei o onegaishimasu.
The bill, please.
Payment routines vary between restaurants. Follow the staff's instructions and check whether you should pay at the counter. Keep one useful phrase ready instead of trying to memorise a whole conversation.
